subject: TitanStream renewal: ops evaluation and potential platform replatform
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@titanstream.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@edgecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation kickoff and vendor heads-up

Aisha — thanks for the time today. As I mentioned on the call, our infra team has run a quick set of microbenchmarks and were seeing latency and cost delta vs the other provider that we cant ignore.

Were planning a short proof sprint next week (duration: 3 days) to reproduce at scale and compare throughput/99p latency on a customer workload. BenchmarkLabs will run the test and share a report. We want all vendors to provide:
- run instructions and a reproducible workload artifact
- a representative config that matches our production footprint (8x A100-ish equivalent, mixed sequence lengths)
- any suggestions youd like them to try (quantization, KV caching, batch sizing)

Also flagging that procurement is asking for a committed price and capacity quote by EOD Friday if we remain in contention. If Redwood can show parity on the core metrics, TitanStream is likely to keep us for chat and embeddings, but if the other vendor proves materially cheaper at 99p latency we will consider replatforming.

Attaching the BenchmarkLabs preview they shared.

--
Samir Gupta
Head of Platform
TitanStream

Attachment: titanstream_q2_benchmark_summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@titanstream.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff and vendor heads-up

Samir — thanks for the heads up and the summary. Well prioritize this.

Quick notes:
- Im looping Markus (performance lead) and Nikhil (solutions) to own the runbook and config.
- We can provide a single-file reproducible workload and step-by-step run instructions (well include KV caching on/off variants and two quantization profiles).
- For committed capacity pricing, I can put together a 12-month reserved capacity proposal with a guaranteed SLO and a mid-term re-eval clause.

Can you confirm the exact p99 targets and the test windows? Also, can BenchmarkLabs share the trace sample that produced the 99p numbers? That will help us tune the profiles quickly.

Ill send proposed artifacts by tomorrow EOD.

Best,
Aisha
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff and vendor heads-up

Adding technical plan here.

Plan for the 3-day sprint:
Day 0 (prep): share runbook + docker images + workload artifact. Ill include a \"fast path\" config (max KV caching, aggressive batching) and a \"safe path\" config (no caching, conservative batching).
Day 1: run baseline (no optimizations) to reproduce BenchmarkLabs numbers.
Day 2: iterative tuning (quantize to int8, enable prefix caching, tune batch size) to chase 99p and tail latency.
Day 3: final verification and produce a short report (latency percentiles, token cost, memory footprint).

We should also offer a temporary dedicated pool for the test (isolated hardware) to remove noisy neighbor variance. Ill draft a proposed-dedicated-config.xlsx and a minimal SLA for the window.

Ill prepare runbook-repro-instructions.txt and upload all artifacts to the Drive folder Aisha created.

-MK
From: Victor Rios <victor@benchmarklabs.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>, Samir Gupta <samir@titanstream.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Trace + test logistics

Aisha — attaching the trace sample and log snippet that produced the earlier summary. Well stand up the harness in TitanStreams staging and run the vendor jobs back-to-back to keep the comparison clean. Please provide the image digest you want us to run and any config knobs.

We can start Monday (6/14) at 09:00 PT if Redwood is ready — otherwise well shift.

Attachment: run-trace-sample.json (json)
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@titanstream.ai>, Victor Rios <victor@benchmarklabs.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trace + test logistics

Team — were locked for the Monday slot. Artifacts are uploaded:
- runbook-repro-instructions.txt (includes image digest + args)
- proposed-dedicated-config.xlsx (hardware and instance sizing)
- a lightweight wrapper image that pulls our latest runtime and a pinned model version.

Markus: please be ready to join the kickoff at 09:00 PT and monitor the p99 trace. Nikhil: can you prepare a short statement on commercial relief (credit for migration risk or a temporary price match) well offer if TitanStream asks during the sprint? Id like to have a firm number pre-approved.

Samir — to help procurement move: Redwood can offer a 3-month pro-rated credit on committed capacity if we meet the verification targets (p99 within 10% and token cost within 12% of the competitor). Were open to a 12-month reserved capacity contract thereafter. Ill have the exact credit math from Nikhil by EOD Friday.

Thanks — looking forward to a clean test.

Aisha
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>, Samir Gupta <samir@titanstream.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Commercial relief proposal

Samir / TitanStream team — per Aishas ask, here's the commercial fallback were prepared to put on the table contingent on meeting the verification targets during the sprint:

Offer summary:
- 3 months pro-rated credit equal to 25% of committed monthly spend (applied if test meets p99 <= competitor*1.10 AND token cost <= competitor*1.12)
- Option to convert to a 12-month reserved capacity contract at a 20% discount to on-demand list for the committed capacity band
- Dedicated test pool for the sprint at no charge; we will provide the proposed-dedicated-config.xlsx and operational runbook
- SLA addendum for the reserved contract (99.9% uptime and 99p latency SLOs for inference requests)

If this looks reasonable, Aisha can include the numbers in the formal commercial proposal and Ill prep a redline-friendly term sheet.

-Nikhil
